name: Stable Diffusion 1.5 economical
notes: 512x512, one image at a time is the economical starting point.
Less prompt fidelity and detail than modern image models; not suitable for rendered UI text.
Weights are a community mirror of the deprecated Runway repository; verify its provenance before installation.

hardware.guidance: Start with one output. Check free GPU memory and model disk sizes; tier is a relative recommendation, not a measured guarantee.

setup: Confirm the selected recipe and output goal with the user.
Inspect comfyui-catalog get_runtime_status for GPU and version; ask for hardware if unavailable.
Download the listed weights only after the user chooses the plan; retain model license terms.
Place files in the listed models/<directory> folders and refresh ComfyUI model discovery.
For image inputs, use comfyui-assets upload_image and pass its input-relative name.
Run prepare_asset_workflow; resolve blockers before generate_asset.
Poll the returned prompt_id, then download prompt-owned artifacts and review them in the target engine.

name: TRELLIS.2 native PBR prop
license: MIT for TRELLIS.2; vision encoder has separate DINOv3 terms
notes: Recent native ComfyUI nodes required; not the third-party TRELLIS2 wrapper.
1024 cascade, mesh simplification and UV/PBR baking; no rigging, LODs or collision.
Target faces is a simplification request, not a guaranteed mesh count.
Microsoft reference implementation requires a 24 GB NVIDIA GPU; native/offloaded execution must be measured.
PBR maps include base color, metallic and roughness; no baked normal/AO in this recipe.

name: Pixal3D native PBR prop
license: MIT for Pixal3D; DINOv3 and dependencies retain their own terms
notes: Recent native Pixal3D + MoGe nodes required; 1024 cascade with INT8 weights.
MoGe estimates reference-camera FoV; not a fixed guessed camera.
Upstream standalone --low_vram uses on-demand loading and defaults to 1024; this ComfyUI recipe does not invoke that CLI flag.
Actual peak VRAM depends on native ComfyUI offloading and mesh complexity; no unverified minimum VRAM claim.
Simplification and UV/PBR baking included; no rigging, LODs, collision, normal or AO baking.
